children: (“CI GAM”) announces the following special reinvested distribution for CI U.S. 1000 Index ETF (Unhedged Common Units) (Cboe: CUSM.B). The special reinvested distribution will be reinvested on September 22, 2026, to unitholders of record on September 21, 2026. The special reinvested distribution will not be paid in cash, but will be reinvested, and the resulting units immediately consolidated, so that the number of units held by each investor will not change.
The following amount is for the special distribution only and does not include the regular quarterly cash distributions.
